courses.name: Master of Public Health
courses.summary: Public health master’s programmes examine population health, prevention, epidemiological methods, health systems and research. Universities may use MPH or MSc award titles, with different qualifying-degree requirements and curricula. Compare the exact degree, supervision, delivery arrangements and costs.
courses.metaDescription: Compare MPH programmes by qualifying subjects or degree, selection, duration, campus, practical study and complete fees.

courses.name: M.Sc. in Epidemiology
courses.summary: M.Sc. in Epidemiology examines disease patterns in populations, epidemiological study design and the interpretation of health data. Curricula may include surveillance, statistical methods, field investigation and research projects. Specific entry qualifications and research arrangements vary by university.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.Sc. Epidemiology programmes, entry requirements, curriculum, delivery arrangements and published fees before applying.

courses.name: M.Sc. in Statistics
courses.summary: Compare statistics master's degrees abroad by probability, inference, modelling, computation, research and applied projects, with tuition, prerequisite mathematics and admissions requirements. Verify whether each university offers a standalone master's route or a doctoral pathway.

This is a communication qualification; it does not confer a licence to practise medicine.

universities.name: The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University
universities.summary: The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University is a state health-sciences university established under the 1987 Act and functioning since July 1988. Alongside its affiliating role, its own Department of Epidemiology at Guindy in Chennai conducts postgraduate study in public health, epidemiology, biostatistics and medical journalism.
universities.campusLifestyle: The university’s own Guindy department brings together postgraduate study and health research. The Department of Epidemiology describes a first year of coursework and research training followed by thesis work for its Epidemiology MSc. Academic activity, departmental assessment and supervision depend on the exact degree. These university-taught routes are separate from programmes delivered by affiliated medical and allied-health colleges across Tamil Nadu.
universities.cityProfile: The university is at 69, Anna Salai, Guindy, Chennai 600032. Applicants should use the Department of Epidemiology address and current university instructions for these courses. Chennai offers a large urban health and research environment, but admission does not establish a hospital appointment, clinical placement or access to every affiliated institution.
universities.practicalExposure: Public health and epidemiology study involves population-health questions and research methods; biostatistics focuses on the analysis of health data. The department describes dissertation work within its Epidemiology MSc. Medical journalism concerns the communication of health information. These academic awards do not independently confer a medical licence, specialist registration or guaranteed employment.
universities.hostelOverview: Obtain current accommodation information directly from the university before arranging a move to Chennai. The university lists an auditorium and guest-house facility, but that listing does not establish a student hostel entitlement or an accommodation charge for these programmes. Confirm availability, eligibility, location and payment terms separately.
universities.dietarySupport: Ask the university about current food facilities near the teaching department and any arrangements linked to accommodation. Plan meals around the actual academic timetable and communicate dietary or accessibility requirements in advance. A tuition or application payment should not be assumed to include meals.
universities.safetyOverview: Use the university’s official website and departmental contacts to confirm admissions, teaching arrangements and payments. Keep copies of submitted applications and official receipts, verify the exact beneficiary before a transfer, and obtain local emergency and campus contact information before attending. Admission to a university programme does not imply access to clinical work beyond its stated academic scope.
universities.studentSupport: The university provides a regional medical library, virtual-library links, examination services and departmental contacts. Application forms request qualification records and provide an eligibility-certificate route for candidates from other universities. Obtain the next cohort’s document checklist and confirm any equivalent or foreign qualification before payment.

admissionsContent.scope: Own Department of Epidemiology academic programmes at Guindy, Chennai; affiliated-college courses and professional clinical training are separate.

faq.question: Are these courses taught directly by the university?
faq.answer: The current 2026–27 notice identifies the Department of Epidemiology of The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University as conducting these four programmes. They are distinct from the extensive courses offered by the university’s affiliated colleges.

faq.question: Which MSc Public Health qualifications are accepted?
faq.answer: The current notice lists full-time recognised BSc routes in specified life-science, statistical and related subjects, named health and allied-health bachelor degrees, and BE Civil. The exact degree title matters; applicants should obtain a university assessment of equivalent qualifications.

faq.question: Can any science graduate apply for MSc Epidemiology?
faq.answer: The notice gives a specific list of medical, health and postgraduate qualifications. It includes MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, BVSc, MPT, MOT and MPharm, along with named MSc degrees. It does not list a generic BSc route.

faq.question: What does MSc Biostatistics require?
faq.answer: The qualifying degree must have Statistics as the main branch or as an ancillary or allied subject. The notice does not replace this degree-level condition with school-level Mathematics or Statistics.

faq.question: Who may apply for Medical Journalism?
faq.answer: The current notice accepts a recognised undergraduate degree obtained full-time in the 10+2+3–5-year pattern. It states no upper age limit, encourages Tamil journalists and allows service candidates. This is a journalism qualification, not a medical-practice licence.

faq.question: Is admission currently open?
faq.answer: The revised 2026–27 notice set 28 June 2026 for the diploma and 29 August 2026 for the MSc applications. Those dates have passed. Future applicants should wait for the next official departmental announcement and confirm available seats and selection arrangements.

faq.question: What is the programme fee?
faq.answer: A current isolated tuition tariff for these own-department routes is not established here. Request the full course-specific quotation, compulsory charges and refund terms from the department. The published ₹885 is an application or processing charge, not tuition.

faq.question: Which documents are required?
faq.answer: The current forms request a photograph, birth-date and community proof, and academic qualification details. The MSc form also asks for professional registration where applicable and eligibility/migration certificates for candidates from other universities. Follow the next cycle’s exact checklist.

faq.question: What language and timetable should I expect?
faq.answer: The currently linked 2019 MSc Public Health regulation specifies English instruction and examinations. Confirm current arrangements for the other named courses directly. The Medical Journalism predecessor regulation describes periodic contact classes; obtain the timetable for the current renamed award rather than assuming daily full-time classes.

faq.question: Can a foreign qualification be used?
faq.answer: The published routes list recognised prior qualifications but do not establish an unrestricted international admission route. Obtain a written university assessment of degree equivalence, eligibility documentation, applicant category, attendance requirements and charges before relying on an offer.
